h1: Custom Koi Badges for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom Koi badges in bulk. Perfect for employee IDs or event credentials. Fast turnaround from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Koi badges offer a durable, professional option for organizations that need reliable identification for employees, volunteers, or event staff. Made with high-quality materials and available with full-color imprinting, these badges resist wear in daily use. Choose from multiple attachment styles including magnetic backs or pin clasps. Custom Koi badges work well for trade shows, corporate offices, or school districts where clear branding and quick recognition matter.
heroAltText: Custom Koi badges with full-color imprint, magnetic back, and professional finish for employee IDs.
